stories.headline: Microsoft Leases Crusoe's New 900 MW AI Data Center Campus in Abilene, Texas

key_facts.fact: Microsoft will lease a new 900 MW data center campus being built by Crusoe in Abilene, Texas, after Oracle and OpenAI withdrew from expanding the adjacent site.
key_facts.excerpt: Bitcoin farmer turned bit barn builder... Microsoft takes up residence next to OpenAI, Oracle at Crusoe's 900 MW Texas datacenter expansion

key_facts.fact: The new campus will include two data halls each supporting 336 MW of critical IT load, with 900 MW of on-site power generation, bringing total campus capacity to 2.1 GW.
key_facts.excerpt: Two new data halls, each supporting 336 MW of critical IT load... Total campus capacity will reach 2.1 GW (up from existing 1.2 GW)

key_facts.fact: Only about 200 MW of the existing 1.2 GW facility is currently operational, with the remaining 1 GW expected online throughout 2026 and Microsoft's new campus anticipated by mid-2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Only ~200 MW of the existing 1.2 GW currently operational... Remaining 1 GW of existing capacity expected online throughout 2026... Microsoft's new campus anticipated operational by mid-2027

key_facts.fact: Crusoe CEO Chase Lochmiller said the project will integrate 900 MW of new on-site power generation to build 'the industrial foundation for American AI.'
key_facts.excerpt: By integrating 900 megawatts of new on-site power generation, we will continue building the industrial foundation for American AI — at a velocity the industry has never seen.

key_facts.fact: The project is part of the broader $500 billion Stargate initiative announced last year.
key_facts.excerpt: Part of the $500 billion Stargate initiative announced last year

stories.headline: Meta Funds 7 New Gas Plants for Louisiana Hyperion Data Center, Totaling 10 Plants and 7.5 GW

key_facts.fact: Meta is paying for the construction of seven new natural gas-fired plants through Entergy Louisiana to power its Hyperion data center, adding to three plants already approved last year for a total of 10.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta orders 10 gas-fired power plants for its Hyperion AI campus in rural Louisiana—more than triple the initial plan

key_facts.fact: The 10 gas plants will provide 7.5 GW of capacity, with an additional 2.5 GW of renewable energy and battery storage planned, representing over 30% of Louisiana's entire grid capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: Total capacity: 7.5 gigawatts from gas plants... Up to 2.5 gigawatts including battery storage... More than 30% increase to Louisiana's entire grid capacity

key_facts.fact: The energy infrastructure is estimated to cost nearly $11 billion, with Meta paying directly rather than shifting costs to ratepayers.
key_facts.excerpt: Estimated cost: Nearly $11 billion... Meta's role: paying for the projects rather than shifting costs to ratepayers

key_facts.fact: Entergy Louisiana says the deals will save Louisiana taxpayers approximately $2 billion over 20 years, bringing total projected benefits to $2.65 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Entergy Louisiana has announced a new agreement with Meta that is expected to deliver approximately $2 billion in customer savings over 20 years, bringing total projected benefits to $2.65 billion

key_facts.fact: The Hyperion campus spans 2,250 acres in Richland Parish with an additional 1,400 acres acquired in February 2026, and has up to $27 billion in total development costs through a Blue Owl Capital partnership.
key_facts.excerpt: Original acreage: 2,250 acres in rural Richland Parish... Additional acquisition: 1,400 acres (acquired February 2026)... Joint venture: Blue Owl Capital partnership with up to $27 billion total development costs

sources.title: Meta orders 10 gas-fired power plants for its Hyperion AI campus in rural Louisiana
Meta will fund seven new natural gas plants to power its biggest data center yet

stories.headline: Google's TurboQuant AI Memory Compression Sparks $100B Memory Chip Stock Selloff

key_facts.fact: Google Research detailed its TurboQuant compression algorithm, which cuts the memory capacity needed to operate AI models to about one-sixth of previous levels while sharply improving inference speed.
key_facts.excerpt: TurboQuant cuts the memory capacity needed to operate AI models to about one-sixth of the previous level, while sharply improving inference speed

key_facts.fact: US memory chip stocks lost approximately $100 billion in market value during the week, led by Micron's 15% weekly drop.
key_facts.excerpt: US memory chip stocks lost ~$100B in market value this week, led by Micron's 15% drop, after Google Research detailed its TurboQuant compression algorithm

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix shares fell approximately 6%, Samsung Electronics dropped about 5%, and Japan's Kioxia fell roughly 6% following the announcement.
key_facts.excerpt: SK Hynix: ~6% drop, Samsung Electronics: ~5% drop, Kioxia (Japan): ~6% drop

key_facts.fact: TurboQuant compresses the key-value cache in large language models, raising fears about reduced demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips essential for AI training and inference.
key_facts.excerpt: Investors feared declining demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips previously considered essential for AI model training and inference

key_facts.fact: Analysts counter the selloff, arguing that resolving memory bottlenecks will strengthen AI hardware performance and drive demand for more powerful training, suggesting long-term memory demand remains resilient.
key_facts.excerpt: If bottlenecks are resolved, AI hardware performance will instead be strengthened and more powerful training models will emerge

sources.title: Google TurboQuant sparks memory chip selloff, shocking Hynix and Samsung investors

stories.headline: Sony Japan Suspends Nearly All Memory Card Sales Due to Global AI-Driven Semiconductor Shortage

key_facts.fact: Sony Japan halted orders for nearly its entire SD and CFexpress memory card lineup, including all CFexpress Type A models (240GB to 1920GB), CFexpress Type B (240GB and 480GB), and all high-end TOUGH-branded SD cards.
key_facts.excerpt: Sony has announced that it is suspending fulfillment of all orders for nearly its entire SD and CFexpress memory card lineup

key_facts.fact: Only two product lines remain available: the 960GB CFexpress Type B card and the SF-UZ series SD cards (UHS-I, already discontinued in the US).
key_facts.excerpt: Only two product lines continue production: 960GB CFexpress Type B card and SF-UZ series SD cards

key_facts.fact: Sony attributed the shutdown to a 'global shortage of semiconductors (memory) and other factors,' citing inability to meet demand 'for the foreseeable future.'
key_facts.excerpt: Sony attributed the shutdown to 'global shortage of semiconductors (memory) and other factors,' citing inability to meet demand 'for the foreseeable future'

key_facts.fact: The shortage is driven by 'the seemingly endless hunger of AI datacenters for memory,' as enterprise companies consuming finite memory component supplies drive both price increases and supply constraints.
key_facts.excerpt: The semiconductor scarcity stems from the seemingly endless hunger of AI datacenters for memory

key_facts.fact: This represents the photography industry's first major casualty from the AI-driven semiconductor shortage, with no resumption date provided.
key_facts.excerpt: This represents the photography industry's first major casualty from the AI-driven semiconductor shortage

sources.title: Sony Shuts Down Nearly Its Entire Memory Card Business Due to SSD Shortage
Sony temporarily suspends memory card sales due to shortages

stories.headline: Google Nears $5B+ Deal to Finance Nexus Data Centers' Texas Campus Leased to Anthropic

key_facts.fact: Google is nearing a deal to provide over $5 billion in financing for Nexus Data Centers' Texas campus, which will be leased to Anthropic upon completion.
key_facts.excerpt: Google Plans to Provide Over $5 Billion in Support for Anthropic's Texas Data Center Project

key_facts.fact: The facility spans approximately 2,800 acres and is expected to deliver around 500 MW of computing power by the end of 2026 at the earliest, with plans for further expansion.
key_facts.excerpt: Approximately 2,800 acres with expected delivery of around 500 megawatts of computing power by the end of 2026 at the earliest, with plans for further expansion

key_facts.fact: The data center will utilize natural gas pipelines with its own gas turbines to reduce reliance on the public power grid.
key_facts.excerpt: The data center will utilize natural gas pipelines with its own gas turbines to reduce reliance on the public power grid

key_facts.fact: The financing deepens Google's partnership with Anthropic, building on previous TPU computing support provided through Google Cloud. Google owns 14% of Anthropic.
key_facts.excerpt: Google is reportedly nearing a deal to help finance Nexus Data Centers' Texas campus that is leased to Anthropic, as Google deepens its partnership with the company

stories.headline: Waymo Hits 500,000 Paid Robotaxi Rides Per Week Across 10 US Cities

key_facts.fact: Waymo announced it is now providing 500,000 paid robotaxi rides per week across 10 US cities, a tenfold increase from 50,000 weekly rides in May 2024.
key_facts.excerpt: Waymo is now providing 500,000 paid robotaxi rides per week... Weekly paid trips have increased tenfold in less than two years

key_facts.fact: The company's fleet of approximately 3,000 vehicles, unchanged since late 2025, averages roughly 23 paid trips per vehicle per day, reflecting major software optimization.
key_facts.excerpt: Approximately 3,000 vehicles (unchanged since late 2025)... Roughly 23 paid trips per vehicle per day

key_facts.fact: Waymo is transitioning to 6th-generation systems using Zeekr Ojai minivans and Hyundai Ioniq 5 platforms, moving away from the Jaguar I-PACE to reduce bill of materials costs.
key_facts.excerpt: Transition to 6th Generation systems using Zeekr Ojai minivans and Hyundai Ioniq 5 platforms, moving away from the Jaguar I-PACE

key_facts.fact: The tenfold ridership growth without proportional hardware expansion suggests routing algorithms and remote assistance fallback mechanisms have matured significantly.
key_facts.excerpt: The routing algorithms and the remote assistance fallback mechanisms have matured significantly

key_facts.fact: The partnership covers Agile Robots' full hardware lineup including the Agile ONE humanoid, Agile Hand, FR3 force-sensitive arm, Diana 7 arm, and Thor series robot arms.

stories.headline: TSMC's 3nm Capacity So Constrained Only 'Long-Term, Loyal' Customers Get Priority

key_facts.fact: TSMC's 3nm process capacity is so constrained that the foundry is prioritizing only 'long-term, loyal customers,' with Apple and Nvidia receiving preferential access, according to DigiTimes.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple and Nvidia receive preferential access to TSMC's 3nm process technology due to their long-term partnerships

key_facts.fact: Companies targeting mass-market consumers, including Intel and AMD, face significantly reduced production allocations compared to preferred clients.
key_facts.excerpt: Companies targeting mass-market consumers, including Intel and AMD, face significantly reduced production allocations

key_facts.fact: Almost all key players in the industry — from processor and video card manufacturers to large cloud providers — are seeking to place orders with TSMC, creating a two-tier allocation system.
key_facts.excerpt: Almost all key players in the industry — from processor and video card manufacturers to large cloud providers — are seeking to place orders with TSMC

key_facts.fact: Rising costs accompany the constraints, with capacity allocation becoming a major operational problem for companies as limited supply drives elevated pricing.
key_facts.excerpt: Capacity allocation and procurement become major operational problems amid limited supply and elevated pricing

key_facts.excerpt: Artemis 2 astronauts arrive at Kennedy Space Center ahead of NASA's historic launch around the moon

key_facts.fact: The mission is targeted for an April 1, 2026 launch and will be the first crewed lunar flyby in over 53 years, since Apollo 17 in 1972.
key_facts.excerpt: No fooling — NASA moving full-speed toward an April 1 launch

key_facts.fact: The crew will fly around the Moon aboard NASA's Orion spacecraft atop the Space Launch System rocket, marking the first humans to travel beyond low-Earth orbit since Apollo.
